mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the triceps was most worthwhile: the opposing pulls explained how muscles can bend and straighten the elbow even though each muscle pulls.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grouping the fibres was straightforward and contributed less on its own; the later sheath and tendon result gave the bundle more purpose.

surprise.text: The connective tissue sheaths gathering into tendons made the connection between a fibre bundle and its pull on bone clearer.

arbitrary.text: Adding vessels made sense as a supply connection, although their exact role was less explicit in this chapter than the muscles' opposing actions.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the unfinished connection to a larger circulation makes me curious how the arm's cellular work will be supported by a body system.
